synthesis.body: `tools/test_build_gate_chain.py` pins the exact `build-check` step sequence in `EXPECTED_SCRIPT_STEPS`. Adding a step to `tools/repo/build_gate_chain.py` makes `make build-check` run it and pass, while Gate F (`pytest tools/test_build_gate_chain.py`) fails — the local gate exercises the chain, the CI gate asserts its shape. A green `make build-check` says nothing about that list. Adding a gate step means editing three places: the chain, `EXPECTED_SCRIPT_STEPS`, and `build-check.yml` plus its `STEP_DISPOSITION` entry in `tools/lint-ci-parity.py`.

title: make build-check runs the gate chain; it cannot detect a step missing from the chain's own pinned list
